4/10/73
1510 WINDER STREET . RICHMOND, VIRGINIA + 23220
355-9170
March 26, 1973
Mr. Theodore R. Robb Curtis Building 6th & Walnut Streets Philadelphia, Pa. 19106
Re:Draft Environmental Impact Statement Project # Va.R-58 HUD-RO-3-E1S-73-2(D)
Dear Sir:
Whereas, the Randolph Planning Study Board is the duly recognized Project Action Committee of the Randolph Urban Renewal Area and is responsible for citizen involvement and planning with regard to the physical planning for the Randolph Area; and
Whereas, in carrying out its responsibility to the Randolph Community we find, after review, the Draft Environmental Statement favorable to the concepts of the Randolph Plan and note however the the Map, Figure #3, should be re-labled in part to show Area I as Area II and Area II as Area I to comply with the language describing the Physical Character of the Area, (article 5, on page 8); and
Whereas, the designed staging phases of the action within the Randolph Area will determine the physical happenings hearest to and abounding the proposed Expressway with regard to the noise factor;
Now therefore, be it resolved that: 1. The Draft Environmental Impact Statement be noted as favorable, with no positive alternative, to the area residents plan and the Project Action Committee efforts. 2. Verification: I affirm this to be the action taken by the Randolph Planning Study Board at a Call Meeting, Sunday, March 25, 1973, at 4:30 p.m., in the Randolph Planning Office, 1610 Winder Street.
cc: Mr. Frederic A. Fay, Executive Dir.-RRHA
Mr. George Cheadle Director- FMA
Mr. Mm. J. Leidinger, City Manager 'Mr. Carroll Mason, H.U.D. Area Office
Sincerely,
Petronius S. Jones, Chairman RANDOLPH PLANTING STUDY BOARD
